messages:
Anjali Rao: Quick sync — gating checklist for tomorrow's release. We need to confirm (1) who has keystore (KMS/HSM) access for the canary deploy, (2) audit-log retention setting for the env, and (3) PRs that still block the SOC2 control sign-off. @Tom @Priya
Tom Wu: I can own keystore access for staging. Do we need an access review ticket? :thinking:
Priya Singh: I already started one — PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/keystore-access/pulls/48 needs one more review from infra. It's about IAM tweaks and KMS key policy.
Liam O'Connor: For prod HSM rotation gating, ops wants the audit logs to be >=90 days for the upcoming assessment. Which env are we talking about here?
Anjali Rao: Start with staging+preprod for the canary, but prod retention policy also needs quick confirmation. @Noah can you confirm current TTL for audit logs in prod?
Noah Miller: prod-audit logs are set to 365d by default, but nonprod was at 30d last I checked. I can extend nonprod to 90d tonight if that's the consensus. :+1:
Priya Singh: Please wait on expanding nonprod until after the smoke test — we don't want sudden storage surges. Maybe extend preprod only for now.
Tom Wu: Access flow: I'll open a temporary grant for anjali@redwood and priya@redwood for the canary window. Command I used last time:
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore --member='user:anjali@redwood' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```
Anjali Rao: Thanks. Can you add a note in the ticket about TTL change being temporary and revert plan?
Tom Wu: Will do. I'll also ping infra-approvals.
DevOpsBot: [deploy-bot] canary deployment queued: keystore-service v1.12.3 -> staging at 23:30 UTC
Priya Singh: Blocker PRs: keystore-access #48 (infra review), audit-config #210 (tests failing intermittently), ci/policy #92 (lint fix). I can try to push a quick fix for audit-config test by EOD.
Liam O'Connor: If audit-config test is flaky, let's add a smoke-run to the canary pipeline to fail fast. We ran that last month and it saved time.
Anjali Rao: Agreed. TODOs: Tom — temp grants + ticket note. Noah — extend preprod logs to 90d after smoke. Priya — triage/pr fixes. Liam — add smoke run to canary. I'll collect confirmations here and update the SOC2 control checklist.
Noah Miller: Confirmed I will extend preprod to 90d after the smoke passes. I'll post the retention change YAML in the ticket.
Tom Wu: Grant created and ticket updated: https://tickets.internal/RED-1234 — added revert plan and grant expiry 2024-06-15. :white_check_mark:
Priya Singh: Pushed audit-config fix attempt, triggering CI now. :crossed_fingers:
DevOpsBot: [ci] audit-config tests started (run id: 87654)
Anjali Rao: Love it. If CI green and smoke pass, we'll mark the control as 'ready for gate' and I will ping compliance. Otherwise, we'll delay. Thanks all. :eyes:
